_about: B2 batch glossary (home, learn/plugins-and-cordis, tours/life-of-a-headless-task). Owner: B2 writer. Search core.json and other batch files before you add a term here.

effect.short: A reversible registration a plugin makes on a context, made with ctx.effect() or ctx.on(). It unwinds on its own when the plugin unloads or reloads.
effect.long: {{cite docs/cordis-primer.md:13}}. A core example: AgentRegistry.setFactory() registers inside ctx.effect() and returns the disposer that clears the slot ({{cite packages/core/agent/src/index.ts:384-392}}).

typed-event.short: A named extension point a service declares, dispatched as emit, waterfall, parallel, serial or bail, depending on how its listeners must run.
